problem_statement: Vision-language models like CLIP demonstrate strong zero-shot capabilities but struggle with generalization to novel classes and cross-dataset transfer. Existing prompt learning methods introduce additional parameters but lack efficient multi-modal representation alignment. MMRL++ addresses this by introducing learnable representation tokens with a parameter-efficient shared-residual design that enhances both visual and textual encoders while maintaining alignment with pre-trained CLIP features.

modules.name: MultiModalRepresentationLearner_pp
modules.description: Core module with learnable representation tokens (compound_rep_tokens) that are projected to both visual and text modalities via Shared-Residual Representation Aligner (SRRA)
key_components: srra_r2vproj: Shared-Residual Representation Aligner for visual projection
srra_r2tproj: Shared-Residual Representation Aligner for text projection

modules.name: Shared_Residual_Representation_Aligner
modules.description: Parameter-efficient module using shared base weights with layer-specific low-rank residual adaptations (LoRA-style)
modules.architecture: Base linear layer + per-layer residual aligners with rank-r decomposition (A @ B)

modules.name: Residual_Aligner
modules.description: Low-rank residual adapter: weight + (A @ B) where A and B are learned matrices

modules.name: CustomCLIP
modules.description: Modified CLIP model integrating representation learner with frozen CLIP encoders
components: image_encoder: Modified CLIP visual encoder with representation token injection
text_encoder: Modified CLIP text encoder with representation token injection

modules.name: TextEncoder_MMRLpp
modules.description: Text encoder that injects representation tokens into transformer layers

model.trainable_params_description: Only representation_learner parameters, image_encoder.proj_rep, and SRRA residual adapters (A, B matrices)

training.loss: MMRLpp_Loss (weighted combination of cross-entropy on original and representation-enhanced logits + cosine similarity regularization)
frozen_components: CLIP image encoder (except proj_rep and SRRA adapters)
CLIP text encoder (except representation token projections)

evaluation_modes.base_to_novel: Train on base classes (16-shot), test on base and novel classes separately
evaluation_modes.few_shot: Train with 1/2/4/8/16 shots per class, test on all classes
evaluation_modes.cross_dataset: Train on ImageNet, test on 10 target datasets + 4 ImageNet variants

inference_strategy.cross_dataset_target: Use original CLIP logits on target datasets
